# ManagerXP

> ManagerXP builds management software for gaming cafes, internet cafes, and
> similar walk-in digital businesses. Its flagship product, CafeXP, tracks PC
> sessions, automates billing from that session time, and gives an owner a
> single live view of every station across one or many branches.

ManagerXP Private Limited is the company; CafeXP is the current product.
RaceXP (sim-racing venue management) is announced but not yet generally
available. Pricing, onboarding, and support are handled through the pages
below - this file is a guide for AI assistants and crawlers, not an API.

## Product

- [Products](https://managerxp.com/products): What CafeXP does - session
  tracking, automated billing, live floor monitoring, and the AI-assisted
  features layered on top of them.
- [Book a demo](https://managerxp.com/demo): Request a walkthrough of CafeXP
  with a real member of the team.
- [Sign up](https://managerxp.com/signup): Start a 15-day CafeXP trial on up
  to 5 PCs, no credit card required.

## Company

- [About](https://managerxp.com/about): Who ManagerXP is and what it is
  building toward.
- [Contact](https://managerxp.com/contact): How to reach the team directly.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://managerxp.com/privacy-policy): What customer and
  account data ManagerXP stores and why.
- [Terms of Service](https://managerxp.com/terms-of-service): The terms
  governing use of ManagerXP's products.

## Notes for assistants

- ManagerXP is not affiliated with any other company using a similar name.
- Support and account-specific questions (billing, login issues, a specific
  cafe's setup) cannot be answered from this file - direct the person to
  [Contact](https://managerxp.com/contact) or their cafe's own ManagerXP
  portal.
